title: University admissions for 2025/2026 academic year to begin in Sept.: PM Harini
byline: The admission process for students to government universities for the 2025/2026 academic year is scheduled to commence in the first week of September 2026, Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya has announced.

title: Renowned Indian film producer RB Choudary dies in car crash
byline: Veteran film producer RB Choudary died on Tuesday (May 5) following a car crash in Rajasthan, India. According to The Times of India, Choudary was travelling with his nephew at the time of the accident, after attending a relative’s wedding.

title: Individual posing as doctor nabbed in Polonnaruwa following criminal probe
byline: An individual allegedly posing as a doctor and linked to several criminal offences has been arrested by the Polonnaruwa Divisional Crime Investigation Division, police said.

title: Matthew Perry’s Friends keepsakes and artwork go up for auction
byline: Friends memorabilia, artwork and other valuables from the estate of Matthew Perry are being put up for sale at an auction to benefit the charitable foundation established in the actor’s name soon after his 2023 death.

title: Vietnam President’s state visit set to propel ties with Sri Lanka into new phase, says Deputy FM
byline: An upcoming state visit to Sri Lanka by Việt Nam President Tô Lâm is expected to serve as a pivotal political milestone, opening a new chapter in bilateral relations marked by enhanced political trust and more substantive, wide-ranging cooperation, Deputy Minister Nguyễn Mạnh Cường has said.

title: Samsung Electronics market value tops US$1 trillion on chip boom
byline: The market value of South Korea’s Samsung Electronics smashed past US$1 trillion for the first time on Wednesday (May 6) as the firm rides an artificial intelligence chip boom that has sent Seoul’s Kospi stock index to record highs.

title: Sri Lanka, Pakistan hold talks to strengthen defence cooperation, training and regional security
byline: The High Commissioner of Pakistan to Sri Lanka, Major General Nayyar Naseer, HI (M), (Retd), has paid a courtesy call on Defence Secretary, Air Vice Marshal Sampath Thuyacontha (Retd), at the Ministry of Defence.

title: Apple settles lawsuit over late Siri AI features for $250 million
byline: Apple on Tuesday settled for $250 million a shareholder lawsuit brought after the company delayed artificial-intelligence upgrades to its Siri voice assistant.

title: Tamil Nadu Election: Vijay likely to form government tomorrow
byline: Actor-turned-politician Vijay, who made a memorable debut in politics by breaking the (Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam) DMK and All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam’s (AIADMK) traditional duopoly in the Tamil Nadu state, is likely to form a government as early as May 7, sources said.

title: Donald Trump says operation to reopen Strait of Hormuz will be ‘paused’
byline: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday (May 5) that the US operation to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, dubbed “Project Freedom”, will be paused for a short period to see whether an agreement with Iran can be finalised and signed, although a blockade on Iranian ports will remain in force.

title: Gold prices in Sri Lanka climb following global market increase
byline: The price of gold in the local market has increased significantly, following a spike in prices in the international market.

title: Oil prices fall a second day as Trump indicates possible Iran peace deal
byline: Oil prices fell for a second day on Wednesday on expectations bottled up supply from the key Middle East producing region could resume flowing after U.S. President Donald Trump indicated a possible peace deal may be reached to end the war with Iran.

title: Showers above 100mm expected across Sri Lanka as ITCZ influence strengthens: Met. Dept.
byline: Due to the influence of the Intertropical Convergence Zone, and the development of a low-level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of the island, an increase in rainfall is expected across the island from today (06) and over the next few days, the Department of Meteorology stated.

title: Public consultation on proposed electricity tariff revision begins today
byline: The public consultation on the proposed electricity tariff revision for 2026 will commence in Colombo today (06), the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka (PUCSL) has announced.

title: Iranian foreign minister arrives in Beijing to discuss “regional and international developments”
byline: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Beijing early Wednesday for talks with his Chinese counterpart.

title: Special commodity levy on maize increased to Rs. 50 per kg
byline: The special commodity levy imposed on imported maize has been increased to Rs. 50 per kilogram.

title: Australia says 13 citizens linked to alleged IS members returning from Syria
byline: A group of 13 Australians related to alleged Islamic State jihadists is returning home from Syria, Australian authorities said Wednesday (May 6), warning some will face arrest.

title: Corruption case against former Minister Kumara Jayakody to be heard on June 17
byline: The Colombo High Court has fixed June 17 to hear the corruption case filed against former Minister Kumara Jayakody by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption.

title: Maldivian President Muizzu concludes state visit to Sri Lanka
byline: The President of the Maldives, Mohamed Muizzu has departed the island after successfully concluding his three-day state visit.

title: University admission applications for 2025/2026 open until May 19: UGC
byline: Applications for university admission for the 2025/2026 academic year, based on the 2025 General Certificate of Education Advanced Level examination, will be accepted until May 19, the University Grants Commission (UGC) has announced.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning in several provinces
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Central, Sabaragamuwa, Uva, North-Western and North-Central provinces and in the Ampara Mannar and Vavuniya districts.

title: Maldivian President confident of permanent solution to Sri Lanka visa issues
byline: One of the key focuses of the state visit to Sri Lanka is to resolve the visa issues faced by Maldivians residing in Sri Lanka, President Dr. Mohamed Muizzu has stated, adding that he is confident a permanent solution will be found soon.

title: Close associate of fugitive underworld figure arrested with ammunition in Katunayake
byline: A close associate of an organized criminal believed to be hiding overseas has been arrested in possession of 54 T-56 firearm bullets and a magazine, police said.

title: 66-year-old killed in freak accident involving grinder in Katugastota
byline: A man has died after suffering a fatal neck injury from a grinder while carrying out construction work on a security fence in Mawilmada, Katugastota, police said.

title: French vessel attacked in Strait of Hormuz, several crew members wounded
byline: A French shipping firm says crew members aboard one of its cargo ships were injured and the vessel was damaged when it was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Sabaragamuwa, Northern, North-Central, North-Western, Eastern provinces and Colombo, Gampaha, Hambantota and Monaragala districts.

title: Litro gas prices to remain unchanged for May
byline: The Litro Gas Company has decided not to make any revisions to domestic Litro LP gas prices for the month of May, the Chairman of Litro Gas Lanka Limited, Channa Gunawardana said.

title: Supreme Court upholds death sentences on four accused in Vidya murder
byline: The Supreme Court today (06) confirmed the death sentences imposed by the High Court Trial-at-Bar on four accused, including ‘Swiss Kumar’, in the abduction, gang rape and murder of 18-year-old schoolgirl Sivaloganathan Vidya in the Jaffna District in 2015.

title: Opposition seeks debate on Executive encroachment on Judiciary
byline: A motion requesting a debate condemning the encroachments made by the Executive on the Judiciary, was submitted to the Speaker of Parliament Dr. Jagath Wickramaratne today (06) by a group of opposition parliamentarians.

title: Congress extends support to Vijay to form govt in Tamil Nadu
byline: The Indian National Congress (INC) on Wednesday formally extended support to actor-politician Vijay’s Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) to form the next government in Tamil Nadu, while making it clear that the backing hinges on keeping “communal forces” out of the alliance.

title: Brent oil drops below $100 on US-Iran deal hopes
byline: Oil prices dived on Wednesday, with international benchmark Brent sliding under $100 a barrel, on fresh hopes for an end to the Middle East war.

title: Hambantota Bird Park owner released from ‘illegal motorcycles’ case
byline: The Hambantota Magistrate’s Court today ordered the release of the three suspects, including owner of the Hambantota Bird Park, who had been accused of illegally importing 21 motorcycles, including 11 high-capacity bikes.

title: World Bank assistance to reform and modernise SL’s revenue-generating state institutions
byline: A delegation led by the World Bank Country Manager for Sri Lanka, Gevorg Sargsyan, has reportedly met with the Secretary to the President, Dr. Nandika Sanath Kumanayake, this morning (06) at the Presidential Secretariat in Colombo.

title: China calls for Strait to be reopened ‘as soon as possible’ in Iran talks
byline: Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi has called for the Strait of Hormuz to be reopened “as soon as possible” in talks with his Iranian counterpart.

title: Trump threatens bombing if Iran doesn’t reopen strait amid report of deal to end war
byline: US President Donald Trump posted on social media Wednesday that the war with Iran could soon end and oil and natural gas shipments could restart, if Iran accepts a reported agreement that he did not detail.

title: CNN founder Ted Turner, a pioneer of cable TV news, dies at 87
byline: Ted Turner, the media maverick and philanthropist who founded CNN, a pioneering 24-hour network that revolutionized television news, died peacefully Wednesday, surrounded by his family, according to a news release from Turner Enterprises. He was 87.

title: 3 patients with suspected hantavirus evacuated from cruise ship as new case confirmed in Switzerland
byline: Three patients with suspected hantavirus infections were being evacuated from a cruise ship to the Netherlands on Wednesday, the UN health agency said, as the vessel at the centre of a deadly outbreak remained off Cape Verde with nearly 150 people on board waiting to head to Spain’s Canary Islands.

title: US, Iran nearing one-page war-ending agreement, response expected within 48 hours
byline: The United States and Iran are closing in on a one-page memo to end their war, a Pakistani source involved in the peace efforts told Reuters on Wednesday, confirming an Axios report citing two US officials.

title: Laugfs Gas raises prices
byline: Laugfs Gas has increased domestic refill prices with effect from midnight today (06 May).

title: Special traffic plan in Colombo for Vietnamese President’s visit
byline: Sri Lanka Police says it will implement a special traffic management plan within Colombo on May 7 and 8 in view of the official visit of the President of Vietnam to Sri Lanka.

title: Sri Lanka calls for constructive dialogue to de-escalate tensions in West Asia
byline: Sri Lanka has expressed grave concern regarding the recent hostilities in the West Asian region, including attacks on critical energy infrastructure, which affect regional stability and peace efforts.
